title: Restart level leaves the game paused instead of running
observed: After esc (pause) and click:btn-restart, the event 'restart' fires and score/lives/timer reset, but mode stays 'paused' and the game does not resume.
expected: Restart level resets the level and the game is running again straight away (section 7), so mode should be 'playing'.

title: HUD Coins stays 0/5 after collecting a coin during a dash
observed: dash-down collects a coin (coins=1, Score 100), but the HUD reads 'Coins 0/5'.
expected: The HUD always shows the current coin count, so it should read 'Coins 1/5'.

title: Spikes wrap score to 65136 instead of subtracting 500 and clamping at 0
observed: Score 100 steps onto spikes and jumps to 65136 (lives 2, respawn). This looks like a 16-bit unsigned wraparound of 100-500.
expected: Spikes cost 500 points with the score never going below 0, so score should be 0 with one life lost.

title: Score goes negative (-300) after a coin pickup following a spikes wrap
observed: Score is 65136 after spikes, then becomes -300 when a coin is collected on the next dash.
expected: Score is never negative and only spikes or a restart may reduce it. Spikes should have clamped the score at 0, and a coin should add 100.

title: Toast covers the pause menu Resume button
observed: With the 'Key collected' toast visible, pausing shows btn-resume with top=false, so a click at its centre does not reach the button.
expected: Every visible button must be clickable, so nothing (including a toast) may cover Resume.
